options.label: Branch here, carry edits (Recommended)

Trail served and the first game is on the board.

**Trail 10** · [Swap the paper background for a soft sage green](https://entire.io/gh/elizabethsiegle/sf-stairs-map/trails/10) on branch `sf-stairs/green-background` (branched from `main` in place, so your 5 uncommitted runner edits came along with it).

**Runners configured** (all 7 in `.entire/runners/`, trail-scoped, enabled, push-triggered):

| runner | agent | triggers | result |
|---|---|---|---|
| trail-review | claude/sonnet | push | code_review_comments |
| trail-risk, trail-drift, trail-confidence, trail-security, trail-slop-gate | claude | api, push | trail_monitor |
| trail-summary | claude/haiku | api, push | trail_summary |

Your five retuned prompts are intact. I added one clause to `trail-review` aimed at exactly what this trail can break: a theme color applied to only some of the places the old value lives (`:root`, sticky footer, `theme-color` meta) or one that drops contrast below WCAG AA.

**The work** (`src/style.css:1`, `index.html:6`): `#f6f4ee` → `#eef2ea` in `:root`, the sticky footer's `#f6f4eef5` → `#eef2eaf5`, and the `theme-color` meta. Card surfaces (`#fdfcf8`, `#fffdf8`) stayed off-white so they still read as raised. Text contrast `#2c342e` on the new sage is 11.4:1.

**Verification.** `npm ci`, `npm run build` (tsc + vite) clean, `npm test` 14/14 passing, plus a rendered check: `ROOT_BG rgb(238, 242, 234) | FOOTER rgba(238, 242, 234, 0.96) | THEME #eef2ea`. One catch worth knowing: my first test run was a let cord. A stale vite server from a different clone (`~/Desktop/demos3idkman/sf-stairs-map`) holds port 5173, and `reuseExistingServer: true` quietly pointed Playwright at it, so that green pass was measuring someone else's court. I re-ran everything against this checkout on port 5199. That other server is still running, untouched.

Two things for you:

1. Looking at the screenshot, the sage is honest but quiet: it reads as warm-neutral-turned-cool more than "green." Happy to push it to something like `#e4ecdf` if you want the green to actually announce itself.
2. Nothing is committed. Say the word and I'll commit and push, which is what fires the runners on this trail.
